new_models: Experimental reconstructions only, original frozen settings; no original model overwrite.

blocked_validation.method: 3-fold nonshuffled GroupKFold over 12 TRAIN operating blocks
blocked_validation.weights: Fold-fit population only; balanced across observed fit classes
blocked_validation.missing_class_policy: Report support and observed-class macro metrics; absent-class AP/recall null; zero probability for unseen fit classes.

clipping.population: Complete frozen TRAIN; validation block13 comparisons
clipping.settings: Original RF E4 estimator parameters, seed42, n_jobs2; class weights recomputed from TRAIN only

calibration.OOF: 4 deterministic source-position tile folds; tile256 positions, 64-position purge around held-out tiles
methods: sigmoid OVR on raw probabilities, C=1e6
calibration.normalization: Independent class mappings clipped to [1e-12,1] and row-normalized
calibration.selection: Lowest OOF multiclass log loss, then Brier; freeze before new TEST diagnostics
calibration.final_fit: All block14 for each predeclared method; TEST comparisons descriptive, no retrospective winner selection
calibration.threshold_policy: No calibrated threshold is fitted. Original archived threshold .5913558658757772 applies only to original RF probabilities; historical block14 threshold exposure is disclosed.
calibration.limitations: One operating block; artificial source tiles are not verified independent sessions. Historical model selection/threshold/test exposure persists.

uncertainty.unit: 12 TRAIN operating blocks with grouped-OOF RF predictions
uncertainty.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentiles; conditional on all five true classes supported; rejected replicates recorded
uncertainty.limitations: Exploratory conditional interval, not guaranteed population coverage; class1 comes from only block12; two TEST blocks cannot establish reliable external-generalization confidence intervals.

stress.constraints: Clamp perturbed electrical values to >=0; missing-channel offline adapter keeps eligibility/abstention policy; API rejects missing inputs.

subgroups: TRAIN quartiles for temperature/output/imbalance; irradiance physical regimes <100,100-400,400-800,>=800; fixed before TEST metrics
shift: TRAIN decile reference bins, PSI epsilon1e-6; KS statistic and Wasserstein/IQR; do not interpret dependent-row iid p-values
physical_baseline: Binary current-imbalance score, threshold TRAIN unlabeled q99; no physical subtype diagnosis
RF_permutation: 200 block13 rows per class, seed42, 3 repeats per physical channel; descriptive not causal
synthetic_investigation: Unchanged existing presets; TRAIN-only nearest-neighbor reference and class distributions; no scenario tuning against TEST
